name: Embroidery
overview: Scripture reveals embroidery as a divinely appointed art integral to the tabernacle and priestly garments, crafted with skill and purpose. The curtains of the tabernacle were embroidered in blue, purple, and scarlet with cherubim designs, while the high priest's coat, girdle, and mitre featured intricate needlework interwoven with gold. This sacred craftsmanship was carried out under the divine inspiration of Bezaleel and Aholiab, highlighting embroidery's role not only in beauty but in holiness and service to God.
